name: io.github.smeet666/mcp-animenewsnetwork
description: Search the Anime News Network encyclopedia and read its news wire. No API key.

environmentVariables.name: ANN_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Override the User-Agent sent to Anime News Network.

environmentVariables.name: ANN_MIN_INTERVAL_MS
environmentVariables.description: Minimum milliseconds between requests. Default 1100, floor 1000.

environmentVariables.name: ANN_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: silent, error, info or debug. Default error.
